author: domlov
body:
Hello, just a couple months ago i started playing minecraft after a long hiatus of playing other games, that day i tried to connect to the avicus network only to see that i was banned permanently. I then recall that 2 years ago my bro installed hacks on my account and used em on this network, i myself however, really enjoyed this server for its nebula. I would kindly ask to get unbanned and would appreciate it if any work was done. I really enjoy this server and would hate to get banned permanently for the rest of my days of playing PC.

Thanks
       domlov

title: how to get unbanned?

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

Since you've remained banned for a long period of time, your infraction will be lifted. Welcome back and be sure to read through the rules once again!

Regards,
Fouled
